html:
Quest Giver: Ranger Equipment Token Master

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go talk with the Ranger Token Master in Townston.

Quest Reward: None listed in the client files

Return to: Ranger Equipment Token Master

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 2b

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go talk with the Ranger Token Master in Townston.

Offer:

Sir Ving is always asking such interesting questions. It's amusing.

Yes, I did get some bad King's Coins. I sent a note to the Townston Lieutenant about them, but I haven't heard back from him yet. Thanks for checking on this on your own time. From reviewing my receipts, I have the impression they may be coming from the Shadow's Embrace.

You should go talk with the Ranger Token Master...I think she was passed some. I can give you my sales receipts, if you would like to examine them. Also, you should ask the other Token Masters for their receipts to examine.

Turn-in:

I'm the Ranger Token Master. Can I help you? You say you'd like to see my recent receipts?

Objectives:

  • Sales Receipts ×1

Client level range: 47–100
